FRIERENMOD-READING_GRIMOIRE_EVENT.title: A New Beginning
“Wow, what a tall tower!”

Just as you are looking forward to exploring another labyrinth, the three grimoires in your suitcase begin to [jitter]stir[/jitter]. Perhaps the great whale nearby has something to do with it…
Choose an initial [gold]Magic Factor[/gold] for each of your three slots.

“Wow, what a tall tower!”

Just as you are looking forward to exploring another labyrinth, the three grimoires in your suitcase begin to [jitter]stir[/jitter]. Perhaps the great whale nearby has something to do with it…
Choose an initial [gold]Magic Factor[/gold] for your [gold]draw slot[/gold].

You feel the [gold]Mana[/gold] flowing within you [sine]begin to change[/sine]…

The factor is now installed in your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold]. It draws on the [gold]Mana[/gold] in that pile.
Choose an initial [gold]Magic Factor[/gold] for your [gold]Hand slot[/gold].

You feel the [gold]Mana[/gold] flowing within you [sine]begin to change[/sine]…

The factor is now installed in your [gold]Hand Slot[/gold]. It draws on the [gold]Mana[/gold] in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
Choose an initial [gold]Magic Factor[/gold] for your [gold]discard slot[/gold].

After examining the grimoires, you notice that some of your [gold]Mana[/gold] has [sine]taken shape[/sine].

Before setting off, take your [gold]Unbelievable Tools[/gold] along, too.
At last, it begins. Go and enjoy an adventure story of your own.
Continue to the great whale’s blessing.
FRIERENMOD-FOOD_EVENT.title: A Culinary Journey
FRIERENMOD-FOOD_EVENT.pages.INITIAL.desc: Climbing the Spire has left you [sine]hungry and empty-bellied[/sine]. You simply must treat yourself to something [sine][green]delicious[/green][/sine]. You decide...
FRIERENMOD-FOOD_EVENT.pages.FREE.descrip: You glance at your [sine]flat wallet[/sine] and shake your head. Free samples at the shop it is. [sine]Everything tastes better when it is free.[/sine]
FRIERENMOD-FOOD_EVENT.pages.PACKAGE.desc: There is no time to [sine]savor a meal[/sine], so you hastily pack the food to take with you. This should keep you fed for a while.
FRIERENMOD-FOOD_EVENT.pages.MEAL.descrip: You arrive at a ball as a diner rather than a dancer. The delicious [green]strawberry cake[/green] alone makes the trip worthwhile. Greedily, you pocket an extra [green]strawberry[/green] for later.
FRIERENMOD-FOOD_EVENT.pages.FEAST.descri: A generous feast leaves you feeling refreshed.
FRIERENMOD-FOOD_EVENT.pages.INITIAL.opti: Pay [gold]150[/gold] [gold]Gold[/gold]. Gain [green]Mercury Pudding[/green] and heal [green]{MealHeal}[/green] HP.
Pay [gold]250[/gold] [gold]Gold[/gold]. Gain a [green]Mango[/green] and heal to full HP.
FRIERENMOD-KRAFT_GIFT.title: Kraft's Gift
FRIERENMOD-KRAFT_GIFT.pages.INITIAL.desc: A [jitter][blue]blizzard[/blue][/jitter] catches you on your travels. You take shelter in an abandoned cabin and find another [sine][blue]elf[/blue][/sine] inside, doing squats to keep warm. After [sine]hundreds of years[/sine], you have finally met another [blue]elf[/blue]: [blue]Kraft[/blue]. You happily talk about times past and present. As you part, Kraft offers you a [sine][green]farewell gift[/green][/sine]...
FRIERENMOD-KRAFT_GIFT.pages.MEAT.descrip: Kraft notices your [sine][blue]hearty appetite[/blue][/sine] and gives you some [green]Meat on the Bone[/green]. That takes care of food for the next few days.
FRIERENMOD-KRAFT_GIFT.pages.MEMBERSHIP.d: After years of ascetic training, Kraft is not as wealthy as you. Still, he digs out a [green]Membership Card[/green] from a few centuries ago and gives it to you, hoping it still works.
FRIERENMOD-KRAFT_GIFT.pages.RING.descrip: Astonished by your [sine]mountain of luggage[/sine], Kraft recommends the virtues of [blue]traveling light[/blue]. To put his own advice into practice, he gives you the [sine][green]Serpent Ring[/green][/sine] he received on his travels.
FRIERENMOD-KRAFT_GIFT.pages.LEAVE.descri: You decline his gift. Kraft smiles. [sine]“Frieren, I will save it for the next time we meet. Farewell.”[/sine] You are certain you will meet again, even if it takes another [blue]few hundred years[/blue].
FRIERENMOD-KRAFT_GIFT.pages.INITIAL.opti: Lose [red]10[/red] HP. [green]Obtain Meat on the Bone.[/green] Requires at least [gold]80[/gold] Max HP.
Pay [gold]100[/gold] [gold]Gold[/gold]. [green]Obtain Membership Card.[/green] Requires at least [gold]300[/gold] [gold]Gold[/gold].
[green]Obtain Serpent Ring.[/green] Become [red]Cursed[/red] - [red]Writhe[/red]. Requires at least [gold]30[/gold] cards in your deck.
FRIERENMOD-ANIMAL_WELL.title: Adventure Story: Animal Well
FRIERENMOD-ANIMAL_WELL.pages.INITIAL.des: You spot a strange well and jump in without a second thought. Your instincts tell you there must be [sine][blue]incredible treasure[/blue][/sine] inside! You enter a pixelated world, its surroundings [sine][blue]eerie yet beautiful[/blue][/sine]. You glance back. [jitter][red]A giant ostrich is charging straight at you![/red][/jitter]
FRIERENMOD-ANIMAL_WELL.pages.FIRECRACKER:
You hastily throw a spare [red]firecracker[/red] from your backpack at the [red]giant ostrich[/red]. While it panics, you flee with the remaining two [red]firecrackers[/red].

[blue]You are safe. For now...[/blue]
FRIERENMOD-ANIMAL_WELL.pages.FLUTE.descr: In desperation, you [sine][gold]play[/gold][/sine] the [gold]Animal Flute[/gold] at hand, hoping to calm it down. As the [sine][gold]notes dance[/gold][/sine], you are transported to a [green]campfire[/green]. You have no idea what happened, but another chance to smith is always welcome.
FRIERENMOD-ANIMAL_WELL.pages.BIRD.descri: After 0.001 seconds of thought, you [jitter]charge straight toward[/jitter] the [red]giant ostrich[/red]! [jitter][red]Its beak is almost upon you![/red][/jitter] [sine]Whoosh—[/sine] You slide to its feet and cast [green]Bird-Capturing Spell[/green] at point-blank range. The [red]giant ostrich[/red] is [gold]frozen in place by magic[/gold]. Such is the composure of a great mage.
FRIERENMOD-ANIMAL_WELL.pages.INITIAL.opt: [green]Obtain a Fire Potion and an Explosive Potion.[/green]
[green]Upgrade[/green] a card. Requires an upgradeable card.
FRIERENMOD-MIMIC_FIGHT.title: Mimic!?
FRIERENMOD-MIMIC_FIGHT.pages.INITIAL.des: A [jitter][gold]glittering treasure chest[/gold][/jitter]! You cast [blue]Meekhite[/blue], your chest-detection spell. There is a 99% chance it is a [red]Mimic[/red]. As a true mage, you decide...
FRIERENMOD-MIMIC_FIGHT.pages.CAUGHT.desc: Sure enough, it is a [red]Mimic[/red], and you have fallen into its mouth! [jitter]So dark! So scary![/jitter] But surely a great mage cannot be defeated by a mere Mimic! You decide...
FRIERENMOD-MIMIC_FIGHT.pages.EXPLODE.des: The Mimic is reduced to ashes. The heat has left your hair in ringlets.
FRIERENMOD-MIMIC_FIGHT.pages.RESCUE.desc: Fern pulls you out with a look of disgust, then destroys the Mimic with a single offensive spell.
FRIERENMOD-MIMIC_FIGHT.pages.INITIAL.opt: [red]Fight the Mimic![/red] [green]Obtain [gold]100[/gold] Gold, Mimic Head, and a Rare relic.[/green]
FRIERENMOD-FOOD_EVENT.pages.INITIAL.opti: Pay [gold]150[/gold] [gold]Gold[/gold]. Gain a [green]Strawberry[/green] and heal [green]{MealHeal}[/green] HP.
FRIERENMOD-SEALING_ORE_MINE.title: Anti-Magic Stone Mine
FRIERENMOD-SEALING_ORE_MINE.pages.INITIA:
You arrive at a mine filled with precious anti-magic stone. Merchants go [jitter]wild[/jitter] for it!

But treasure comes with risk: these stones suppress magic, making them a mage's worst enemy. What will you do?
What is this? Let me try
[green]Remove[/green] a card. Add 1 [gold]Mana[/gold] to your deck for each Energy it costs.
FRIERENMOD-SEALING_ORE_MINE.pages.PLAY.d: You pick up a piece of [gold]anti-magic stone[/gold] and pour [gold]Mana[/gold] into it. Harder than diamond, the [gold]stone[/gold] gives off a dazzling flash, then [gold]shatters[/gold], spilling [gold]Mana[/gold] everywhere. With the entertainment over, you continue your journey.
You pack away [gold]the prettiest piece of anti-magic stone[/gold]. It may [red]interfere with your Chant[/red],

[gold]but the Merchant ahead will surely pay a good price.[/gold]
FRIERENMOD-DEMON_ARMY_ATTACK.title: The Demon Army Attacks
FRIERENMOD-DEMON_ARMY_ATTACK.pages.INITI:
After [red]Aura[/red]’s defeat, nearby [red]monsters[/red] suddenly [jitter][red]run rampant[/red][/jitter]. A local noble sends [gold]Frieren’s party[/gold] an urgent request: support the troops and earn a bounty matching the [sine][gold]danger[/gold][/sine].

[sine][gold]“Don’t worry. We have plenty of vanguards!”[/gold][/sine]
Fight [red]{Boss}[/red]. Start combat with [gold]Barricade[/gold] and [green]8[/green] [gold]Plating[/gold]. Win a [gold]Rare Relic[/gold], [green]2[/green] Potions, and [gold]150 Gold[/gold].
Fight an [red]Infested Prism[/red]. Start combat with [green]1[/green] [gold]Afterimage[/gold]. Win a [gold]Random Relic[/gold], [green]1[/green] Potion, and [gold]50 Gold[/gold].
Fight a [red]Hunter Killer[/red]. Start combat with [green]1[/green] [gold]Artifact[/gold]. Win a [gold]Common Relic[/gold] and [gold]50 Gold[/gold].

FRIERENMOD-HOLLOW_KNIGHT_ADVENTURE.title: Adventure Story: Hollow Knight
FRIERENMOD-HOLLOW_KNIGHT_ADVENTURE.pages: You slip through a [jitter][gold]rift[/gold][/jitter] in the Spire and arrive in [sine][gold]Hallownest[/gold][/sine], an underground kingdom of insects. Its bugs seem infected by some [red]virus[/red], [sine]wandering aimlessly...[/sine] Nearby sits a masked [gold]little knight[/gold] carrying a nail, while a [red]warrior in red[/red] watches you warily. The [gold]little knight[/gold] stares into space from a bench. Perhaps it needs help. You decide to lend a hand.

The [gold]little knight[/gold] says nothing and heads straight toward the [sine][gold]giant moth[/gold][/sine]. The [sine][gold]giant moth[/gold][/sine] rains down [jitter][gold]countless beams of light[/gold][/jitter]. The [gold]little knight[/gold] [sine]glides through the white rain like a dragon[/sine], swinging its nail when it dodges and curling up to try again when it cannot. The hiss of passing [gold]beams[/gold], the rhythm of [gold]nail[/gold] strikes, the whisper of gathering [gold]Soul[/gold]—you lose yourself in the [gold]little knight[/gold]’s solitary [sine][gold]symphony[/gold][/sine]. When you come to your senses, [gold]Absolute Radiance[/gold] has fallen before you. The surrounding [red]shadows[/red] grow [jitter]restless[/jitter]. Before the [red]shadows[/red] swallow it, the [gold]little knight[/gold] teaches you [gold]its greatest secret[/gold].
Fly Through the Path of Pain Together
Take [red]9[/red] damage. Enchant a single-target Attack with [gold]Mark of Pride[/gold].

The [gold]little knight[/gold] hesitates. The Path of Pain bristles with [jitter]deadly traps[/jitter]; a single misstep means doom. You prepare [sine][gold]Flying Magic[/gold][/sine] to carry it over this sea of suffering, but it bars your way with its nail. It seems the [gold]little knight[/gold] wants to find an answer through its own strength. After three days and nights of practice, it finally reaches the end. There is no fabled wealth or glory... Perhaps completing the [gold]trial[/gold] is an honor in itself. You went [red]hungry for three days[/red], but learned that even a bug can take [gold]pride[/gold] in its unyielding spirit.

The [gold]little knight[/gold] seems depressed about something called [red]Silksong[/red]. You remember a Spire spell that lets you [blue]borrow time[/blue]. The [gold]little knight[/gold] eagerly asks you to cast it... Success! You have reached a time when [sine][red]Silksong[/red][/sine] has already been released!
FRIERENMOD-JOJO_ADVENTURE.title: Adventure Story: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
You wander through a [jitter][gold]rift[/gold][/jitter] in the Spire. This time, three [gold]portals[/gold] stand before you.

The first bears a stone mask and reeks of [sine][red]vampires[/red][/sine]. A [blue]diamond[/blue] marks the second, beyond which lies a peaceful town. Through the third, a [wave][gold]grand horse race[/gold][/wave] is underway.

Each has its own allure. In the end, you choose...
Heal [green]8[/green] HP. Enchant a card with [gold]Hamon Overdrive[/gold].
Obtain the Relic [gold]Stand: Ghost In A Flower[/gold].
FRIERENMOD-JOJO_ADVENTURE.pages.MASK.des:
The people here have mastered a technique as powerful as magic: [gold]“Hamon”[/gold].

With [gold]millennia of experience[/gold], you soon grasp the secret of [gold]“Hamon”[/gold]. A special [sine][gold]breathing technique[/gold][/sine] is all it takes to turn the tide.
You enter the Diamond Door. The townspeople also have an ability called a [gold]“Stand”[/gold]. Nearby, a student whose [gold]hair looks like a steak[/gold] faces off against an [sine][gold]ordinary office worker[/gold][/sine].

As you watch, something suddenly appears beside you. Is that... your [gold]“Stand”[/gold]?
FRIERENMOD-JOJO_ADVENTURE.pages.SPIN.des:
You sense that this [gold]horse race[/gold] is far more than it seems.

A [blue]disabled rider[/blue] and his [gold]gold-toothed[/gold] companion keep talking about the [wave][gold]“Spin”[/gold][/wave]. You recall that the Spire is also home to a certain [blue]expert on spinning orbs[/blue].

Perhaps you should ask him about the secrets of the [wave][gold]“Spin”[/gold][/wave] when you return.
FRIERENMOD-SNOW_CRYSTAL_LAND.title: Land of Sacred Snow Crystals
FRIERENMOD-SNOW_CRYSTAL_LAND.pages.INITI:
You arrive in the [gold]Land of Sacred Snow Crystals[/gold], a breathtaking sight.
The nearby villagers say you may admire the [gold]sacred snow crystals[/gold], but [red]must not touch them[/red]. They have guarded this precious land for generations.
Recognizing the legendary [gold]powerful elven mage[/gold], they ask you to cast a [gold]protective barrier[/gold] to keep outsiders and monsters away.
FRIERENMOD-SNOW_CRYSTAL_LAND.pages.TOUCH:
The [gold]sacred snow crystals[/gold] really do possess [gold]mysterious magic[/gold]!
But the villagers no longer [red]trust[/red] this mischievous elf. Was it really worth it?
FRIERENMOD-SNOW_CRYSTAL_LAND.pages.PROTE:
[blue]Himmel[/blue] would have wanted you to do this, too.
You cast a [gold]protective barrier[/gold] over the land. The villagers' gift has a distinctly [gold]northern charm[/gold]. This precious place can look forward to a thousand years of peace.
FRIERENMOD-DRAGON_BALL_ADVENTURE.title: Adventure Story: Dragon Ball
FRIERENMOD-DRAGON_BALL_ADVENTURE.pages.I:
You travel through a [jitter][gold]rift in spacetime[/gold][/jitter] within the Spire. This time, you emerge in a world where [gold]seven Dragon Balls[/gold] can grant a wish.
A tall tower rises in the distance, while a small island lies out at sea. Nearby, people are fighting over a Dragon Ball!
Defeat a {Hp} HP dummy within 3 turns. Obtain a [gold]Senzu Bean[/gold].
FRIERENMOD-DRAGON_BALL_ADVENTURE.pages.K:
You fly to the top of the tower and pass the grueling trial set by a cat sage named Korin.
[gold]Senzu Beans[/gold] are extremely rare. One keeps you [sine]full for ten days[/sine] and quickly [green]heals your injuries[/green]. The only [red]drawback[/red] is that you no longer want anything except [gold]Senzu Beans[/gold].
FRIERENMOD-DRAGON_BALL_ADVENTURE.pages.F: [red]You failed[/red]. Korin puts away the Senzu Beans. At least you have lost nothing.
FRIERENMOD-DRAGON_BALL_ADVENTURE.pages.T:
On the island, a strange old man calling himself Master Roshi looks you over.
“Give me a massage, and I'll teach you the Kamehameha I spent fifty years perfecting.” Cupping his hands, he fires a [blue][jitter]powerful beam of energy![/jitter][/blue]
You mention that you have studied magic for several thousand years, then copy his technique with an even stronger [jitter][blue]Kamehameha![/blue][/jitter]
Unfortunately, [gold]Master Roshi[/gold] fainted the moment he heard [sine]several thousand years[/sine]…
FRIERENMOD-DRAGON_BALL_ADVENTURE.pages.S:
Your [gold]collecting obsession[/gold] takes over. You seize the [gold]Dragon Ball[/gold] by [jitter]brute force[/jitter] and return to the tower to admire your prize.
It takes [gold]seven[/gold] of these to unlock their true power. Now you have a chance to find [sine][gold]the other six[/gold][/sine]!
FRIERENMOD-SUMMON_DRAGON.title: Summon Shenron
FRIERENMOD-SUMMON_DRAGON.pages.INITIAL.d:
With all [gold]seven Dragon Balls[/gold] gathered, you cry out: “Come forth, [green]Shenron[/green]! Grant my [gold]wish[/gold]!”
The sky turns black. The Dragon Balls shine brilliantly, and the heavens split open.
Amid [jitter][gold]deafening thunder[/gold][/jitter], a gigantic [sine][green]Shenron[/green][/sine] rises from a pillar of light and [sine]coils above your head[/sine].
[sine]“[gold]Elf[/gold] who summoned me, speak your [gold]wish[/gold]! Whatever your [gold]wish[/gold], I shall grant you one!”[/sine]
FRIERENMOD-SUMMON_DRAGON.pages.INITIAL.o: Set your current and maximum HP to [green]9999[/green].
[green]Shenron[/green] looks upon the one who gathered all [gold]seven Dragon Balls[/gold].
FRIERENMOD-DEBT_COLLECTOR.title: Debt Collectors
Two burly men call out behind you: “[wave]Hey, you look [gold]familiar[/gold][/wave]. Weren't you on our lord's [jitter][red]wanted poster[/red][/jitter]?”
Pay [gold]{Debt} Gold[/gold]. Enchant an [gold]Honest Work Is Boring, Right?[/gold] with [gold]Loaded Dice[/gold].
Transform an Attack into [gold]Honest Work Is Boring, Right?[/gold]. Obtain [red]Debt[/red].
FRIERENMOD-DEBT_COLLECTOR.pages.INNOCENT: The [gold]lord[/gold] suddenly appears. “Lady [gold]Frieren[/gold]! I mistook you for the [gold]elven mage[/gold] who owed my grandfather's great-grandfather money. My men have been terribly rude. Please accept this [gold]apology[/gold].”
FRIERENMOD-DEBT_COLLECTOR.pages.REPAY.de: Moved by your [gold]honesty[/gold] ([wave][gold]money[/gold][/wave]), the collectors improve your chances of hitting the [gold]jackpot[/gold]. They will never come to collect from you again!
You refuse to change and gamble harder than ever. What's a little more [gold]debt[/gold]?
You have become a [red][jitter]bad girl[/jitter][/red].
FRIERENMOD-DEBT_COLLECTOR.pages.LEAVE.de: The collectors take another look at your face, then turn and leave.
